summary: Exascale Labs Holdings Inc. (formerly D. Boral ARC Merger Corp) filed an 8-K/A amending the 8-K for its completed SPAC business combination with Exascale Labs Inc., consummated August 27, 2026 under a January 11, 2026 Business Combination Agreement. The amendment adds audited Exascale financials for FY2026/FY2025, BCAR interim financials, MD&A, and unaudited pro forma combined information as of June 30, 2026. No deal price, premium, or board recommendation appears in the excerpt; the filing is financial-statement remediation. Watch post-close redemptions, warrant overhang at $11.50, and lock-up expiry.
